question: How do I improve my SEO?
answer: Start with the fundamentals Google uses to understand your page: a unique, well-written title tag (30-60 characters), a compelling meta description (50-160 characters), a single clear H1 heading, and structured data (schema.org) so Google can understand what your business does. From there, focus on genuinely useful content, fast page load, and consistent local signals if you serve a local area. Our free SEO checker scans your site against all of these in under 30 seconds.
